info.name: Atlassian Admin Account Project Classification Levels API
Atlassian Get The Default Data Classification Level Of A Project

params.name: projectIdOrKey
params.description: The project ID or project key (case-sensitive).

items.docs:
Returns the default data classification for a project.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:**

* *Browse Projects* [project permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg) for the project.
* *Administer projects* [project permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg) for the project.
* *Administer jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).
